name_reason: Compliant with naming convention (data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>): prefix data_fd2_, domain ui_menu, descriptor visible_item_count reflects a counter of the roster/item rows the menu renderer paints. No Ghidra address residue. Reflects data type (counter) and matches sibling menu-state globals (data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx / _scroll_offset / _saved_cursor_idx / _saved_scroll_offset).
purpose: Shared menu-row-count state: how many roster/item rows the chapter-intro grid renderer paints for the current selection screen.
logic_summary: BSS uint32, statically zero. Written during setup before the first read on every menu path. fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_main stores the live party-member/roster count each loop iteration; the buy/sell/equip/give/status/promote loops each overwrite it with their own list length (eligible recipients, party member count, or inventory entry count). fd2_run_buy_item_menu snapshots the prior value (MOV EDI,[0x5413F]) and restores it around the recipient-select sub-loop. Read by the grid renderer (fd2_render_chapter_intro_dialog_panels @ 0x2D9FE) and the scroll/nav loops as the visible row bound. Accessed as a full 32-bit dword; the binary's bound checks are signed but the stored value is always a small non-negative row count.
element_semantics: Scalar count of visible roster/item rows for the current chapter-intro/shop selection grid (party-member count, eligible-recipient count, or inventory-entry count depending on the active sub-menu).
